newsitem.title: UK: UK's Northern Rock profits rise 14 pct.
newsitem.headline: UK's Northern Rock profits rise 14 pct.

text.p: Britain's Northern Rock Building Society, due for flotation in the autumn, reported pretax profits of 167.5 million pounds ($270 million) for 1996 on Wednesday, up 14 percent from 147 million in the previous year.
The profits exclude a non-recurring costs of 10.3 million pounds related to the conversion to bank status.
Northern Rock said its post-tax profits rose 15 percent to 112.5 million pounds against 97.8 million in 1995.
Its assets grew 19 percent to 13.7 billion pounds from 11.6 billion.
Its net lending for the year rose 44 percent to 1.9 billion pounds from 1.3 billion with its share in Britain's net mortgage lending market rising to 10 percent from eight percent.
Net receipts from savers rose to 584 million pounds from 560 million in the previous year.
